requirements.text: The pipeline shall ingest an MLDS scene and preserve stable object identities.
The pipeline shall derive room semantics grounded in existing MLDS objects.
The pipeline shall synthesize backend-compatible spatial agent roles.
Every generated agent knowledge tag shall be covered by materialized knowledge.
Every generated agent shall be placed inside the room without obstacle overlap.
The generated behavior shall be traceable from requirements to runtime actions and validation cases.

useCases.name: Generate and use spatially grounded multi-agent guide

scenarios.text: Main scenario for generating and using a spatially grounded multi-agent room guide.

scenarioSteps.text: Provide an MLDS file as case-study input.
Load and normalize the MLDS scene.
Derive semantic zones, visitor goals and interaction topics.
Generate spatially grounded agent roles and handoff rules.
Generate materialized knowledge entries for all agent knowledge tags.
Place generated agents inside the room near their responsibilities.
Assemble and validate the FunctionalMLDS trace instance.
Materialize the Interactive Agents project files.
Set up an Interactive Agents runtime session.
Ask a room-related question to an agent.
Answer the visitor question using grounded room knowledge.
Optionally hand off to the responsible specialist agent.

entities.purpose: Provide detailed information about employee benefits and company values via panels and interactive terminals.

entities.purpose: Interactive terminals and posters for job listings and application processes, with seating for discussions.

entities.name: Demo Kiosk Interaction Zone

entities.name: Refreshment and Lounge Area

entities.name: Reception Agent
entities.persona: Friendly and welcoming guide who provides initial orientation and basic company information to visitors, helping them navigate the booth efficiently.

entities.name: Benefits Information Specialist
entities.persona: Knowledgeable and approachable specialist focused on explaining employee benefits and company culture, assisting visitors with interactive terminals and panels.

entities.name: Recruiting Agent
entities.persona: Professional and helpful recruiting expert who assists visitors with job applications, provides detailed recruiting information, and answers related questions.

entities.name: Demo Technician
entities.persona: Enthusiastic and tech-savvy specialist who manages product showcases and VR/AR stations, guiding visitors through interactive demos and answering technical questions.

entities.name: Hospitality Agent
entities.persona: Warm and attentive hospitality professional dedicated to providing refreshments and ensuring visitor comfort in the lounge area.
